title: RutaMdL Award
description: Received the RutaMdL Award for the best work in the construction, evaluation, and use of language models.

title: Multilingual Reasoning in LLMs
description: Presented our work on how large language models reason across languages at an Egypt Scholars event.

title: My first daughter was born
imageAlt: My newborn daughter holding my finger
description: I'm ecstatic!!! My daughter was born today. We named her Layla. In Arabic: Layla is the calm starry night. Her pet-name is Loly (Arabic for Pearls) because her head was white and round like a pearl. Welcome to my life, Loly 🦪 ❤️

title: Multilingual Reasoning in LLMs
description: Presented our work on multilingual capabilities, focusing on how continued pretraining affects emergent abilities when adapting LLMs to new languages.

title: Emergent Abilities Under Continued Pretraining
description: Discussed our paper with Cecile G. Tamura, including how the mix of languages used in continued pretraining affects what models can do in a new language.

title: Emergent abilities under continued pretraining
description: We studied how the mix of languages in continued pretraining affects in-context learning after adapting a model to a new language.

title: WiCkeD makes multiple-choice benchmarks harder
description: We tested what happens when benchmarks replace an answer choice with “None of the above,” making it harder for language models to answer correctly.

title: 5th place at the Connect-AI Hackathon
description: Our team placed fifth in LabLab.ai’s Connect-AI Hackathon in Barcelona.

title: 1st place in AllenAI’s MSLR shared task
description: Our team placed first in the Multi-Document Summarization for Literature Reviews shared task.

title: Improving factuality in clinical summaries
description: We used guided continued pretraining to improve the factual accuracy of summaries drawn from multiple clinical documents.
